description:
Read-only file metadata operations on Quadratic files the user has access to. No data is modified. Requires authentication.

Files are spreadsheets (kind GRID, edited with read_data / write_data), documents (kind DOC, edited with doc_read / doc_write) or presentations (kind SLIDE, edited with slide_read / slide_write).

Actions:
• list_files(kinds?) — List accessible files with their kind. kinds: ["GRID"], ["DOC"] or ["SLIDE"] limits the list to those kinds.
• get_file_info(file_id) — Get metadata for a single file, including its kind and web URL.

action.description: Action to perform: list_files or get_file_info

params.description: Parameters for the action (see tool description)

name: files_read
